notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.43 adds closable student warning dialogs, identifies new and updated online CBT schedules, and colours tests only when their scores are verified saved online. Academic managers can reactivate score editing for a whole class; Any approved source applies to existing scorebooks and Objective/Theory fields without changing saved marks. The web class register pins student names and fixes the subject dropdown. Back up and close the app before updating both CBT servers between examinations. Do not uninstall or clear saved data. Existing answers, scores and financial records are preserved. No new tablet APK is required.
